lj-000.title: KIRA

dialectExpressions.meaning: I am carving out my own path / pursuing my destiny
No one has the power to obstruct or hinder me
God's protection and grace surround me
It has gone / It's completely settled and elevated

lj-000.canonicalLyrics:
Intro:
(Yeah yeah, Drey Star on the beat)
(Faaji l'oba, otilo)

Chorus:
I dey find my way home (Global Corrected)
Nobody fit stop me when the light come on
Oluwa cover me, I dey go
From Lagos to the globe, they already know
KIRA, KIRA, shine bright in the night
KIRA, KIRA, everything go dey alright

Verse 1:
Came from the mainland with a dream so clear
Talking drums beating loud in my ear
They said I couldn't make it to the premier stage
Now we turning over every single history page
Faaji l'oba, we dey run this town
Never let nobody pull the crown back down

Chorus:
I dey find my way home
Nobody fit stop me when the light come on
Oluwa cover me, I dey go
From Lagos to the globe, they already know
KIRA, KIRA, shine bright in the night
KIRA, KIRA, everything go dey alright

Verse 2:
Island lights flashing on the Lekki drive
Energy so electric, man we feel alive
Sound of the brass and the 808 roll
African heartbeat living in my soul
No bad energy, leave that behind
Focus on the blessings that we came to find

Chorus:
I dey find my way home
Nobody fit stop me when the light come on
Oluwa cover me, I dey go
From Lagos to the globe, they already know
KIRA, KIRA, shine bright in the night
KIRA, KIRA, everything go dey alright

Outro:
(Faaji l'oba, otilo)
KIRA in the sky...
Drey Star, LJ Entertainment worldwide.

fr.title: KIRA (Traduction Française)
fr.chorus: Je retrouve le chemin de ma maison / Personne ne peut m'arrêter quand la lumière s'allume / Que Dieu me protège, je m'en vais / De Lagos au monde entier, ils le savent déjà / KIRA, KIRA, brille fort dans la nuit / KIRA, KIRA, tout ira bien

es.title: KIRA (Traducción al Español)
es.chorus: Encuentro mi camino a casa / Nadie puede detenerme cuando la luz se enciende / Dios me cubra, yo avanzo / De Lagos para el mundo, ya lo saben / KIRA, KIRA, brilla fuerte en la noche / KIRA, KIRA, todo va a salir bien

sw.title: KIRA (Tafsiri ya Kiswahili)
sw.chorus: Ninatafuta njia yangu ya kwenda nyumbani / Hakuna anayeweza kunizuia nuru inapowaka / Mwenyezi Mungu anilinde, ninaendelea / Kutoka Lagos hadi ulimwenguni, tayari wanajua / KIRA, KIRA, ng'aa sana usiku / KIRA, KIRA, kila kitu kitakuwa sawa
